summary.text: Craig Gagnon is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives from District 11, in office since 2012, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Gagnon is assigned to the Labor, Commerce and Industry Committee for 2025-2026.
In 2023-2024 he served on the Regulations and Administrative Procedures Committee and the Ways and Means Committee.

sources.title: South Carolina House of Representatives elections, 2026
